look_here_first: Leafy-stemmed blanketflower with hairy alternate leaves and highly variable yellow/orange-brown rays that may be reduced or nearly absent.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: short-lived perennial; leafy erect stems; alternate hairy leaves; upper leaves sometimes clasping; variable rays; reddish-brown disc
